acceptance: npm run bundle:fetch then npm run build produces the full site from a certified bundle
Guard test passes and is part of the required `ci` aggregate
No read outside the repo except $SITE_INPUTS (guard test proves it)
Built output with SITE_ORIGIN=https://next.benchbox.dev contains no https://benchbox.dev outside the allowlist
context: muse AR-02, AR-07 and AR-14 (accepted). The plan's "every read outside website/" table is the checklist. Paths after the seed rename: explorer/ (was results-explorer/), blog/ (was docs/blog/), inventory/ (was _project/design/site-inventory/).
description:
PR group S1, with site-split-21 and site-split-24.

1. Add `npm run bundle:fetch`. It downloads the newest certified core bundle into `.site-inputs/` (gitignored) and verifies its digest, schema and certified_by. Use `gh run download -R BenchBox-dev/BenchBox` with GH_TOKEN locally. In CI, use a token minted by actions/create-github-app-token (owner BenchBox-dev, repositories BenchBox) and actions/download-artifact with repository, run-id and github-token.
2. Replace every read outside the repo (plan table "every read outside website/"):
   - astro.config.ts: docs from the bundle; CNAME from SITE_HOST; the objects.inv version from the manifest's package_version; `site:` from SITE_ORIGIN (replaces the hard-coded https://benchbox.dev at L84).
   - links.ts:35-75: `repo-files.json` replaces statSync; GitHub URLs are pinned to core_sha instead of `develop` (L13).
   - `_project/design/site-inventory` paths become `inventory/`.
   - prompt-catalog.ts reads the bundle's `prompt-catalog.json`.
   - e2e/not-found.mjs:48-51 reads RESULTS_FALLBACK from a site-owned JSON file.
   - index.astro:125 takes the version from the manifest instead of the hard-coded v0.4.1.
   - header-links.ts:15 imports the workspace package.
   - routes/header.spec.ts drops the docs/_templates and landing/*.html reads.
   - The Explorer scripts (ensure-dev-snapshot.mjs, explorer-build-contract.mjs, generate-/verify-browser-fixtures.mjs) take the snapshot, contract, fixtures and parity fixtures from the bundle, with no uv, python or git calls.
   - Captures write to a gitignored `captures/` directory.
3. edit-url.ts: docs pages edit in core `develop`; blog and site pages edit in the site repo. Drop the prefixes for generated pages.
4. Add a guard test. It fails on:
   - any path that resolves outside the repo (apart from $SITE_INPUTS);
   - any python or uv invocation;
   - any .py file;
   - any hard-coded https://benchbox.dev outside an allowlist.
